csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using System.Text; using UnityEditor; public class Script { public static string Main() { var sb = new StringBuilder(); string p = "Assets/Art/In-Game UI/Button - All.png"; var imp = AssetImporter.GetAtPath(p) as TextureImporter; bool wasR = imp.isReadable; imp.isReadable = true; imp.SaveAndReimport(); var tex = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Texture2D>(p); int w = tex.width; int h = tex.height; sb.AppendLine("Button-All: " + w + "x" + h); var pix = tex.GetPixels32(); sb.Append("TL:rgba(" + pix[0].r + "," + pix[0].g + "," + pix[0].b + "," + pix[0].a + ") "); sb.Append("TR:rgba(" + pix[w-1].r + "," + pix[w-1].g + "," + pix[w-1].b + "," + pix[w-1].a + ") "); sb.Append("BL:rgba(" + pix[(h-1)*w].r + "," + pix[(h-1)*w].g + "," + pix[(h-1)*w].b + "," + pix[(h-1)*w].a + ") "); sb.Append("BR:rgba(" + pix[h*w-1].r + "," + pix[h*w-1].g + "," + pix[h*w-1].b + "," + pix[h*w-1].a + ") "); sb.AppendLine(); int cx = w/2; int cy = h/2; sb.AppendLine("Center:rgba(" + pix[cy*w+cx].r + "," + pix[cy*w+cx].g + "," + pix[cy*w+cx].b + "," + pix[cy*w+cx].a + ")"); int topY = (int)(h * 0.85f); int topPx = topY * w + cx; sb.AppendLine("TopCenter(85%):rgba(" + pix[topPx].r + "," + pix[topPx].g + "," + pix[topPx].b + "," + pix[topPx].a + ")"); imp.isReadable = wasR; imp.SaveAndReimport(); return sb.ToString(); } }
